name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:mocks → /spec:plan → /spec:run (build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.223.0 — The prototype freeze signs in and derives its tier. A host may declare prototype.storageState, a saved Playwright sign-in that every capture loads — at the freeze and at the build's capture gate; a non-string, missing or unreadable file refuses by name before a browser launches, and a login redirect names the stale sign-in or says to declare one. /spec:doctor flags a committed storageState file. The generated spec's tier is no longer hardcoded standard: --mark tests-derived matches the File Plan against the host's pipeline rules § Risk Tiers paths, and any hit refuses until the user passes --tier standard|critical; the spec's Rationale records the basis and the mark prints the derived tier. The grounding contract gains the storageState key, so the contract hash changes and hosts owe a /spec:doctor re-stamp. 7.222.0 — Prototype lane fixes from the walkthrough host: a behaviour-lane build no longer stops at red-check after the harden merge — --mark harden-merged records the merged HEAD as the pre-image, and red-check plus the stub-residue check judge the tree against it, so File Plan files the merge delivered are neither an impure pre-image nor stub residue; diff_base stays at the commit before the merge, so review and the commit reconcile still cover the merged data/API layer. prototype-driver reads a lettered brief id whole (04a-project-notes → 04a, not 04), so status.json, contract.json, the derived test file name, the prototype database name and the generated spec's brief no longer take the neighbouring brief's id, and the reserved spec name drops the letter with the number. 7.221.0 — Build capture gate joins prototype.url onto the relative route addresses the freeze writes in contract.json — a real frozen contract no longer dies on an invalid address at --mark captured; a relative address with no prototype.url declared is refused by name.
